create_vision_model: create a Multimodal2VisionModel instance from a Multimodal2VisionConfig for image feature extraction
build_vision_transformer: build a Multimodal2VisionTransformer that processes pixel values and returns pooled CLS embeddings
test_vision_embeddings: test Multimodal2VisionEmbeddings with dynamic image sizes using interpolate_pos_encoding
